lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular spots are arranged in a grid-like formation across the mid-lateral flank. The largest and highest-luminance spots are concentrated in the central region posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a lattice-like arrangement across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a distinct vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and lower luminance (shadowing) on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The partially visible first dorsal fin on the left frame edge contains approximately 8-10 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, dark-toned objects (remoras) are visible trailing beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral silhouette of the shark.
